environment.description: Same EC2 instance and monolith code, but the application is containerized and orchestrated via EKS with a Pod Security Standards enforcement profile applied at the namespace level. The namespace 'legacy-workloads' has the label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted (Kubernetes 1.28+). The container runs with a read-only root filesystem (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true in the security context), and a single emptyDir volume is mounted at /app/deployments with no subPath escaping possible. The container's securityContext specifies runAsNonRoot: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, and capabilities are dropped (ALL). Additionally, the node uses a custom seccomp profile (deployed via DaemonSet) that restricts symlink-following syscalls and blocks mkdir/open calls to paths outside /app/deployments via a BPF-based path filter. The container image is built with a distroless base, removing shell utilities.

config.seccomp_enforcement: BPF path filter restricting open/openat/mkdir/mkdirat to /app/deployments subtree only
